page.content:
Choose Goose was a talking goose who spoke (almost) exclusively in rhymes. He sold various rare objects for adventuring or assisting Finn and Jake, but most of what he possessed either backfired or was largely useless.

page.overview:
Who is Choose Goose?

Choose Goose is a non-playable character in MultiVersus.

Choose Goose appears during Finn the Human's Grounded Down Special, Sweet Deals!, in which he will sell Finn a speed or a shield buff that last until Finn is killed as well as the use of BMO for a special powerful attack.
